metadata.title: US Animal Shelters Master Database
metadata.description: Consolidated database of all pet shelters, rescue organizations, humane societies, and animal agencies across all 50 US states

organizations.name: Alaska SPCA
organizations.description: Independent local nonprofit promoting animal welfare since 1955. Provides affordable veterinary services, adoption center, pet food bank, and mobile surgery unit.

organizations.name: Anchorage Animal Care and Control
organizations.description: Open-admission municipal shelter serving the entire Municipality of Anchorage. Promotes public health, safety, responsible pet ownership, and humane care of animals.

organizations.name: Juneau Animal Rescue
organizations.description: Private nonprofit shelter founded in 1963, serving domestic animals in Juneau for over 60 years. The largest shelter in Southeast Alaska, operating as an open-admission facility.

organizations.name: Fairbanks North Star Borough Animal Control
organizations.description: Municipal animal shelter serving Fairbanks North Star Borough, providing animal control services and pet adoptions.

organizations.name: Mat-Su Borough Animal Care and Regulation

organizations.name: Humane Society of Kodiak

organizations.name: Ketchikan Humane Society

organizations.name: Friends of Sitka Animal Shelter

organizations.name: Alaska Mindful Paws
organizations.description: Non-profit organization in Homer dedicated to providing shelter, care and advocacy to homeless animals in the community.

organizations.name: Alaskan Animal Rescue Friends

organizations.name: Friends of Pets

organizations.name: Alaska Dog and Puppy Rescue

organizations.name: Second Chance League

organizations.name: Alaska Humane Society
organizations.description: Founded in 1979, operates a no-kill shelter and sanctuary for orphan cats in Anchorage.

organizations.name: Best Friends Animal Rescue Alaska
organizations.description: Registered 501(c)3 non-profit helping families from all over Alaska find their next best friend through adoption services.

organizations.name: Forget-Me-Not Animal Rescue
organizations.description: Animal rescue organization in North Pole, Alaska founded in 2023, dedicated to rescuing and rehoming animals in the Fairbanks area.

organizations.name: Golden Retriever Rescue of Fairbanks
organizations.description: Breed-specific rescue organization dedicated to rescuing and rehoming Golden Retrievers in the Fairbanks area.

organizations.name: Loving Companions Animal Rescue
organizations.description: Animal rescue organization serving the Fairbanks area, dedicated to finding loving homes for companion animals.

organizations.name: HARK - Haines Animal Rescue Kennel

organizations.name: Bering Sea Humane Society
organizations.description: Animal welfare organization in Nome, Alaska founded in 2020 serving the remote Bering Sea region.

organizations.name: Petersburg Humane Association
organizations.description: Animal shelter organization in Petersburg, Alaska founded in 2008 serving the local community.

organizations.name: Helping Escaped and Lost Pets
organizations.description: Nonprofit helping return lost pets home in the Mat-Su Valley, including Palmer, Wasilla, and all of the Mat-Su Borough.

organizations.name: Companions Inc
organizations.description: Pet support volunteers organization serving the Fairbanks area with various animal welfare programs.

organizations.name: Greater Birmingham Humane Society

organizations.name: Greater Huntsville Humane Society
organizations.description: A 501(c)(3) no-kill animal shelter rescuing North Alabama's homeless animals for over 55 years. Incorporated in December 1969. Offers community programs including pet food bank and wellness clinic.

organizations.name: Morgan County Humane Society

organizations.name: Baldwin Humane Society

organizations.name: East Alabama Humane Society

organizations.name: Humane Society of Elmore County

organizations.name: Wiregrass Pet Rescue and Adoption Center

organizations.name: Paws of Dixie Animal Rescue

organizations.name: H.A.S.R.A. - Heart of Alabama Save Rescue Adopt
organizations.description: 501(c)(3) non-profit, no-kill rescue working with the community, taking in dogs that would otherwise end up at animal control facilities or left homeless.

organizations.name: Full Circle Rescue and Sanctuary
